title: What a Godly Man Does at 11 PM When Temptation Hits (It's Not Willpower)
caption:
You can white-knuckle it for a week. Then it's 11 PM, you're tired, and the plan is gone.

Move. Say it to God. Text a brother. Small, physical, and out loud.

Save this for tonight.

#faith #godlyman #temptation #selfcontrol #christianmen
